messages:
Marcus L: Heads up 1 small-screen oddity: when the header morphs at ~610px the condensed toolbar overlaps the row action chevrons. Repro on Pixel 6: open Runs, resize to ~610, tap a row  action menu is under the header. Screenshot: https://redwood-screenshots/header-overlap.jpg :magnifying_glass_tilted_left:

Yara N: I saw that too. Our breakpoint math uses exactly 600px which causes a 10px island where both header and actions think theyre primary. Could we add a 24px transition band (596-620) and animate the header height so the chevrons get pushed smoothly?

Ben F: Technical note: animating height can cause reflow. Better to animate a transform on a wrapper and adjust pointer-events during animation. Example:```css
.header-wrap { transform-origin: top; transition: transform 160ms ease; }
.header-collapsed { transform: scaleY(0.85); }
```

Marta Q: UX concern: if we animate too much, screen readers might not get the state change. Add aria-live="polite" and a brief text update like "Header compacted" for assistive tech. Also ensure focus isn't lost from the action button when the header transitions.

Marcus L: Good call. Also noticed long action labels ("Share run details with team") push the chevron off-screen on small widths. Suggest truncating to one line with an inline ellipsis and moving full text to the action sheet.

Yara N: For table rows with long JSON keys we've been using 1-line ellipsis, but that hides important identifiers. Can we clamp to 2 lines with a "copy" affordance that appears on swipe? Mobile UX: swipe-left reveals tiny actions (Copy, More).

Ben F: Implemented a swipe action prototype locally. Using a translateX with pointer capture and an action layer:```js
row.addEventListener('pointerdown', startDrag);
function openActions() { row.classList.add('actions-open'); }
```Make sure to cancel on vertical scroll > 10px to avoid gesture conflicts.

Marta Q: Accessibility: swipe actions must also be reachable by keyboard. Add a visually-hidden actions button that opens the same menu. Use aria-controls to connect it to the action sheet and restore focus on close.

design-bot: Small checklist: 1) disclose reduced-motion preference for header morph, 2) action sheet role="menu" and proper aria-modal when opened, 3) ensure contrast of action icons >= 4.5:1 on mobile.

Yara N: One extra nit: toast notifications are being shown bottom-center but the slide-up action sheet collides with them on small screens. Recommend toasts move to top-right on widths < 680px or use a defer queue when action sheet is open.

ux-ci-bot: Visual test failed on mobile width 612px (regression id: mobile-header-612-2026-03-23). Keyboard nav test passed for action sheet but focus-restoration failed in Safari iOS 15. Will attach diff.

Marcus L: Action items: Ben to add pointer-capture + vertical-swipe cancel (EOD), Yara to update copy for truncated action labels and hook the hidden actions button, Marta to add aria-live & accessibility checks, design-bot to verify motion prefs. We'll re-run visual tests after. Thanks! :thumbsup:
